mostWorthwhile.text: Making and testing the spring-tide prediction was most worthwhile: it turned a question into a checkable comparison and distinguished supporting evidence from proof.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating Wonder was a rather abstract opening; its purpose only became clearer once it led to a question.

surprise.text: The clarification that a spring tide means a larger tidal range, not a seasonal tide, was a useful surprise.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, though the early abstract Wonder result did not immediately indicate what it would be used for.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing what harder questions the community asks next, particularly if they lead to similarly concrete tests.
